[line]

[heading]📖 Description[/heading]
[b]Seed Planter[/b] is a quality-of-life tool mod created by Willdan12 designed to streamline planting on your farm. Instead of manually selecting and planting seeds tile by tile, simply load your seeds into the [b]Seed Planter[/b], hold the tool, and walk across your tilled soil. The planter will handle the rest automatically!

[heading]✨ Main Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Automatic Planting:[/b] Load seeds into the tool, hold it, and walk over tilled soil to plant seeds automatically without needing to click each tile.[/*]
[*][b]Interactive Seed Tray:[/b] Simply tap/use the tool while holding it to open the seed tray and easily manage your seeds.[/*]
[*][b]HUD Display:[/b] Convenient HUD notifications showing the current loaded seeds and quantity (e.g., showing loaded seeds or letting you know if it's empty).[/*]
[*][b]Crafting Recipe:[/b] Includes a craftable recipe in-game so you can build your own Seed Planter.[/*]
[*][b]Smart Filtering:[/b] Ensures only crop seeds can be loaded into the seed tray.[/*]
[/list]
[heading]🛠️ Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] (Minimum version: [b]4.0.0[/b] or newer)[/*]
[*][b]Stardew Valley[/b] (Latest version compatible with SMAPI)[/*]
[/list]
[heading]📥 Installation Instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Make sure you have [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] installed on your system.[/*]
[*]Download the [b]Seed Planter[/b] mod file from this NexusMods page.[/*]
[*]Extract the downloaded zip file.[/*]
[*]Move the extracted folder into the [b]Mods[/b] directory of your Stardew Valley game folder.[/*]
[*]Launch your game using [b]SMAPI[/b][/*]
[/list]
